Flooring

Premium surfaces

The right flooring is the foundation of your home's aesthetic, setting the tone for every room and providing the tactile surface you interact with most. We provide expert installation of high-durability, premium materials that provide both comfort and lasting beauty, from the timeless warmth of hardwood to the sleek sophistication of large-format tile.

Our installation team is trained in the latest techniques for subfloor preparation and leveling, ensuring a perfectly flat and stable base for your new floors. We specialize in precision cuts around architectural details and seamless transitions between different materials, resulting in a flawless finish that defines the character of your interior spaces.

Whether you choose solid or engineered hardwood, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), or natural stone like travertine, we guide you through the selection process to find the material that best suits your lifestyle and the specific needs of each room. Our commitment to quality ensures that your flooring will remain a beautiful and resilient asset for years to come.

Frequently Asked Questions

What flooring options are available?

Available services include solid and engineered hardwood, porcelain and ceramic tile, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), laminate, and natural stone such as travertine and marble — selected based on room use, subfloor condition, and design goals.

Do you remove existing flooring?

Removal and disposal can be included in the project scope. The existing flooring type and subfloor condition are evaluated first to determine the appropriate removal method and confirm the subfloor is ready for the new installation.

How long does flooring installation take?

Timing depends on area, material, pattern complexity, subfloor preparation needs, removal requirements, and transitions between rooms. The schedule is confirmed for each specific installation.

Do flooring projects require permits?

Standard flooring installation typically does not require a building permit unless the scope includes structural subfloor modifications. Unique Building Contractors evaluates permit requirements based on the specific installation and existing subfloor conditions before work begins.

Can you install flooring throughout a home?

Yes. Whole-home flooring installation can be planned with coordinated transitions, trim, room use, and material suitability all considered together for a cohesive result.
